overview: Medford High School's Mustang Report broadcast featured an interview on the Year Up post-graduation program, a demonstration of a student aquaculture project, and student public service announcements.

items.title: Year Up Program Interview
items.summary: Gigi Braga interviewed guidance counselor Mr. Klein about Year Up, a tuition-free post-graduation program offering college credits, job skill training, and corporate internships.

items.title: Question of the Week
items.summary: Ms. Donlan posed the Mustang Report question of the week regarding her middle name.

items.title: Aquaculture Project Overview
items.summary: A speaker outlined a multidisciplinary aquaculture project where robotics, engineering, and culinary students collaborate to raise and prepare food-grade tilapia.

items.title: Student Skits and Public Service Announcements
items.summary: Students performed public service skits covering medical checkups, seatbelt safety, distracted driving, and school spirit.
